subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Theranos Deception
description: Learn The Theranos Deception in one minute.

hook.text: Elizabeth Holmes promised to revolutionize blood testing. The technology never worked. She raised $700 million anyway.

buildup.text: Theranos claimed to run hundreds of tests from a single drop of blood. Investors and partners believed the vision.

discovery.text: Whistleblowers revealed that Theranos secretly used conventional machines while claiming its technology worked.

twist.text: Board members included Henry Kissinger and James Mattis — impressive names but no medical or tech expertise.

climax.text: Holmes was convicted of fraud in 2022. Theranos is now a case study in what happens when culture punishes doubt.

punchline.text: The tech never worked. She raised $700 million. Nobody asked.

quiz.question: What did whistleblowers reveal about Theranos?
options: It secretly used conventional machines while claiming new technology worked
Its technology was better than advertised
It was making too much profit
